req_text.3: A DH user shall be able to read the temperature at a thermostat position.
req_text.4: A thermostat unit shall communicate, through wireless signals, with the master control unit.
req_text.5: The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
req_text.6: Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.
req_text.7: A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
req_text.8: When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.
req_text.9: The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.
req_text.10: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.
req_text.11: DigitalHome provides a monthly planner.
req_text.12: The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.

items.why: The DigitalHome System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.

The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.
A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.
The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.
The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.
The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.

req_text.1: The DigitalHome System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.

req_text.3: A DH user shall be able to read the temperature at a thermostat position.
req_text.4: A thermostat unit shall communicate, through wireless signals, with the master control unit.
req_text.5: The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
req_text.6: Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.
req_text.7: A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
req_text.8: When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.
req_text.9: The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.
req_text.10: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.
req_text.11: DigitalHome provides a monthly planner.
req_text.12: The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.

req_text.1: The DigitalHome System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.
req_text.2: The DigitalHome programmable thermostat shall allow a user to monitor and control a home’s temperature from any location, using a web ready computer, cell phone, or PDA.
req_text.3: A DH user shall be able to read the temperature at a thermostat position.
req_text.4: A thermostat unit shall communicate, through wireless signals, with the master control unit.
req_text.5: The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
req_text.6: Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.
req_text.7: A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
req_text.8: When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.
req_text.9: The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.
req_text.10: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.
req_text.11: DigitalHome provides a monthly planner.
req_text.12: The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.

req_text.1: The DigitalHome System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.
req_text.2: The DigitalHome programmable thermostat shall allow a user to monitor and control a home’s temperature from any location, using a web ready computer, cell phone, or PDA.
req_text.3: A DH user shall be able to read the temperature at a thermostat position.
req_text.4: A thermostat unit shall communicate, through wireless signals, with the master control unit.
req_text.5: The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
req_text.6: Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.
req_text.7: A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
req_text.8: When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.
req_text.9: The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.
req_text.10: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.
req_text.11: DigitalHome provides a monthly planner.
req_text.12: The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.

req_text.1: The DigitalHome System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.
req_text.2: The DigitalHome programmable thermostat shall allow a user to monitor and control a home’s temperature from any location, using a web ready computer, cell phone, or PDA.
req_text.3: A DH user shall be able to read the temperature at a thermostat position.
req_text.4: A thermostat unit shall communicate, through wireless signals, with the master control unit.
req_text.5: The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
req_text.6: Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.
req_text.7: A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
req_text.8: When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.
req_text.9: The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.
req_text.10: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.
req_text.11: DigitalHome provides a monthly planner.
req_text.12: The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.

req_text.1: The DigitalHome System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.
req_text.2: The DigitalHome programmable thermostat shall allow a user to monitor and control a home’s temperature from any location, using a web ready computer, cell phone, or PDA.
req_text.3: A DH user shall be able to read the temperature at a thermostat position.
req_text.4: A thermostat unit shall communicate, through wireless signals, with the master control unit.
req_text.5: The system shall support Fahrenheit and Celsius temperature values.
req_text.6: Up to eight humidistats shall be placed in rooms throughout the home.
req_text.7: A DigitalHome system shall be able to manage up to fifty door and window contact sensors.
req_text.8: When a security breach occurs and a contact sensor is set OPEN, the alarm system shall be activated.
req_text.9: The system shall be able to provide information about the state of a power switch (OFF or ON), indicating whether an appliance connected to the power switch is OFF or ON.
req_text.10: The system shall be able to change the state of a power switch (OFF to ON, or ON to OFF), in turn changing the state of an appliance connected to the power switch.
req_text.11: DigitalHome provides a monthly planner.
req_text.12: The month report shall contain daily average, maximum (with time) and minimum (with time) values of temperature and humidity for each thermostat and humidistat, respectively.
